multi_entity_note: Single-subject judicial biography; other people named (nominating president, predecessor) are incidental, not parties.

resume.name.rationale: The record heading gives the subject's full name; other names are the nominating president or predecessor/other people.

resume.law_institution.value: Indiana University School of Law -- Bloomington (now Maurer School of Law)
resume.law_institution.rationale: The Education entry with the J.D. names the law school; other schools awarded other degrees or are employers.

resume.law_year.rationale: The year follows the J.D. entry in Education. Other years are birth, judicial-service or career dates.

resume.undergrad_institution.rationale: The Education entry with the bachelor's degree names the institution; the law school entry plays a different role.

resume.undergrad_year.rationale: The year follows the bachelor's degree entry in Education. Other years are birth, judicial-service or career dates.

resume.first_judgeship_start.rationale: Commission date of the first listed federal judgeship; nomination, confirmation, senior-status and other dates play different roles.

resume.latest_position.rationale: The latest listed federal judicial service is this position; the court name alone is partial.
